site.title: NODAYSIDLE
site.description: Native apps for macOS, Linux, Chrome and the web, built by one studio and released on a schedule.

apps.name: VectorStudio
apps.pitch: A small desktop vector editor for Linux that keeps your work on your machine.
apps.description: Shapes, text and a Bézier pen on one page, with layers, a properties panel and undo for every edit. Opens existing SVG files as editable layers and exports SVG and PNG that match the page you drew. Runs natively on Wayland; no account, no network requests.
features: Rectangle, ellipse, triangle, star, line, arrow and text: pick a tool, click to place
Bézier pen with point and handle editing
Layers and properties panel: position, size, rotation, fill, stroke, opacity, align, order
SVG export that keeps rotation, corner radius and text; PNG at 2× of the page only
Opens existing SVG files as editable layers: shapes, paths with holes, text, groups, transforms and gradients
Autosave on your machine, plus Open, Save and Save as for .json design files; Save writes back to the open file

notes.linux: chmod +x the AppImage, then run it. AppImages need FUSE 2 (fuse2 on Arch); without it, run with APPIMAGE_EXTRACT_AND_RUN=1.

apps.githubDescription: Desktop vector editor for Linux: shapes, Bézier pen, layers, SVG and PNG export. Native Wayland AppImage.

media.alt: VectorStudio: layers on the left, the page in the middle, properties of the selected triangle on the right

apps.name: AI Rules Builder
apps.pitch: Create, preview and share AGENTS.md and Cursor rules for AI coding agents.
apps.description: Every coding agent expects a different rules file. Pick the target tool, switch rule sets on or off, and export the correctly named file. It runs in your browser: no account, no database, no tracking.
features: 20 editable rule sets in 7 categories, each switchable on its own
Drop in package.json or requirements.txt and get matching rule sets suggested, parsed in the browser
Output for AGENTS.md (Codex, Command Code, agy, deepseek-harness), .cursor/rules/*.mdc and legacy .cursorrules
Live preview with copy, download and a token estimate
Share links that carry the whole configuration, plus a read-only JSON API at /api/rules
apps.githubDescription: Create and export AGENTS.md and Cursor rules for AI coding agents. Live demo on Vercel.

media.alt: AI Rules Builder: rule switches on the left, live AGENTS.md preview on the right

apps.name: F1 Telemetry Pro
apps.pitch: Formula 1 telemetry analysis and session replay in the browser, on real OpenF1 timing data.
apps.description: Pick up to four drivers and laps from any session since 2023. Speed, throttle, brake, gear, DRS and time delta line up on one distance axis, with a single scrub needle driving every chart and the track map.
features: Up to four drivers compared at once, each with its own season, session, lap and tyre
Track delta map in 100 m micro-sectors: green where the comparison gains, red where it loses
Lift and coast detection marked on the charts and the map
Session replay with every car on the map and a live timing tower
Runs entirely in the browser, with a cache so a reloaded lap needs no network
apps.githubDescription: Client-side F1 telemetry analysis and session replay on real OpenF1 data: 4-driver lap overlays, track delta maps, lift & coast detection, 60 FPS scrubbing.

media.alt: F1 Telemetry Pro: four-driver lap analysis, 2024 Belgian GP qualifying

apps.name: Cascade
apps.pitch: Turn one software idea into five agent-ready markdown contracts.
apps.description: One model call for product meaning; a local TypeScript compiler owns IDs, graph, files, and the five locked documents (PRD, ARD, TRD, TASKS, AGENTS) a coding agent can build from.
features: Semantic intake schema: features, data, integrations, constraints
Five locked presets: macOS SwiftUI desktop & menubar, Tauri 2, Astro, Android Compose
Exact-five export with SHA-256 equality between preview and export
Safe provider boundary: memory-only credentials, at most one repair request

notes.mac: Ad-hoc signed, not notarized. First launch: right-click the app → Open. Fallback: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
notes.linux: AppImage: chmod +x before running. tar.gz needs WebKitGTK 4.1 (e.g. webkit2gtk-4.1 on Arch).

apps.githubDescription: macOS app that turns one software idea into five agent-ready markdown contracts.

apps.name: Sonora
apps.pitch: Universal native desktop music player for Spotify, YouTube Music, and local files.
apps.description: Sample-accurate gapless audio, EBU R128 loudness normalization, and synced lyrics with real-time romanization: built with Tauri 2 and Rust, with no application telemetry.
features: Unified queue for local files, Spotify, and YouTube Music
Sample-accurate gapless transitions via double-buffering pre-roll
Studio-grade EBU R128 loudness normalization (−14 LUFS)
Synced lyrics with Kanji/Hangul/Pinyin/Cyrillic romanization

notes.mac: Ad-hoc signed, not notarized. First launch: right-click the app → Open. Fallback: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.

apps.githubDescription: Universal native desktop music player uniting Spotify, YouTube Music, and Local files. Built with Tauri v2 + Rust + React 19.

apps.name: WhisperBar
apps.pitch: Native, privacy-first macOS menu bar dictation with real-time streaming.
apps.description: 100% native Swift 6 menu bar utility: live transcription HUD, smart LLM refinement when speech needs it, Keychain-only credentials, and zero third-party dependencies. Prebuilt release is Apple Silicon only (macOS 14+).
features: Deepgram Nova live WebSocket streaming with interim HUD preview
Push-to-talk and hands-free toggle modes with system-wide hotkeys
API keys stored only in the macOS Keychain
Local SQLite transcript history with FTS5 search

notes.mac: Ad-hoc signed, not notarized. First launch: right-click the app → Open. Fallback: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Requires your own Deepgram / OpenRouter API keys.

apps.githubDescription: Native, privacy-first macOS menu bar dictation with Deepgram streaming, OpenRouter refinement, and zero dependencies.

apps.name: NODAYSIDLE Browser for Linux
apps.pitch: A quiet, native Linux browser for focused browsing.
apps.description: Minimal chrome and native WebKit pages: Rust, GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1, no Electron runtime, no application telemetry. One Linux x86_64 AppImage with GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1 bundled inside.
features: Native GTK 3 chrome backed by WebKitGTK 4.1
Multi-tab browsing, in-page find, downloads
Multiple windows sharing one profile (Ctrl+N or --new-window)
Hyprland corner inset matching decoration:rounding (0 when tiled, maximized, or fullscreen)
Local-first history and cookies (0600 permissions)

notes.linux: chmod +x the AppImage, then run it. GTK 3 and WebKitGTK 4.1 are bundled inside, so nothing else needs installing.

apps.githubDescription: Native Linux WebKitGTK browser in Rust—focused browsing, local-first, no telemetry.

apps.name: nodaysrammar
apps.pitch: Private, on-device grammar and spell checker for English, Italian, and Slovenian.
apps.description: Works offline with no telemetry; settings sync via Chrome Sync. Engine: ~35k-word dictionaries, grammar rules, and a small JS classifier. Sideload from the release zip: not on the Chrome Web Store.
features: Inline underline with suggestion card
Fix All for the current field
Per-site blocklist
EN / IT / SL with in-page language switch

notes.chrome: Unzip, open chrome://extensions, enable Developer mode, Load unpacked, pick the unzipped folder. Works in Chrome, Brave, and Edge.

apps.githubDescription: On-device, zero-telemetry multilingual grammar and spell checker for Chromium (Manifest V3)

apps.name: Kurek
apps.pitch: A voice assistant daemon for Arch and Hyprland.
apps.description: Middle-click to summon, say what you need, and it acts and answers out loud. Requires your own DeepSeek and xAI API keys. Derived from FatihMakes' JARVIS under CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial).
features: 25 tools, summoned by a small C trigger over a Unix socket
Local faster-whisper speech-to-text and streaming voice replies
Screen vision and a systemd user service
~450MB peak RAM observed with Whisper loaded
Voice control of your PC, including remotely from an Android app over Tailscale (token-authenticated, opt-in with KUREK_REMOTE_BIND=tailscale)

notes.linux: Extract the tarball, run ./install_linux.sh (it prints any pacman packages you need), then bind ~/.local/bin/kurek-trigger toggle in Hyprland. Requires your own DeepSeek and xAI API keys.

apps.githubDescription: Autonomous, sub-second personal AI assistant for Arch Linux (Hyprland) & macOS. Features ~333MB RAM headless daemon, Middle Click   hardware summon, Muse Memory, TypeSafe Jev System One cognitive gating, DeepSeek-Flash reasoning, and xAI Grok (Sol) voice.
